notablePrerequisites:
Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Slobad.
description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts or to cast artifact spells.
Workshop Assistant dies, triggering itself and Slobad.
Resolve the Workshop Assistant trigger, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Slobad trigger, untapping it.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}{R} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts or to cast artifact spells.
Myr Retriever dies, triggering itself and Slobad.
Resolve the Myr Retriever trigger, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Slobad trigger, untapping it.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {3}.
Repeat.
